explanation: His Rebecca (1940) won Best Picture, but that award went to its producer, David O. Selznick. The Academy gave Hitchcock its honorary Thalberg award in 1968.

claims.text: Alfred Hitchcock received five Academy Award nominations for Best Director and won none.
Rebecca (1940) won Best Picture, an award that went to its producer, David O. Selznick.
The Academy gave Hitchcock the Irving G. Thalberg Memorial Award in 1968.
